workflow: The term 'supply chain' refers to the flow of goods and services from the supplier to the customer. It encompasses the movement and storage of raw materials, work-in-process inventory, and finished goods from the beginning of the production process to the end user. It is a key part of a business's operations, since it has a direct impact on the customer experience and competitive advantage.
